title: $Spin(n,n)\times\mathbb{R}^+$ Generalised Geometry and Consistent Truncations on Branes
summary: In this note we show how the consistent truncations on half-supersymmetric branes of Leung and Stelle and Lin, Skrzypek and Stelle fit into the general exceptional generalised geometry analysis of Cassani \emph{et al.}. Each solution defines a torsion-free $Spin(n)$ structure in the $Spin(n,n)\times \mathbb{R}^+$ generalised geometry introduced by Strickland--Constable, where $n$ is the dimension of the space transverse to the brane.
